text:
Maya Patel: Heads-up — Saltbox wants a migration POC next week. They want to verify API parity, security questionnaire answers, and a pricing delta for token billing.
Jordan Lee: Cool — what are their hard blockers?
Maya Patel: Main asks: 1) request/response parity for their current vendor, 2) KMS/HSM integration & key residency, 3) predictable latency under heavy burst, 4) a sealed SOW for Dedicated if perf is good.
Samir Kapoor: For parity — are they using any custom headers or a legacy streaming protocol?
Maya Patel: They call: POST /v1/complete (JSON) + streaming SSE for responses. Also send prompt metadata in `X-Client-Attrs`.
Liam Chen: We can support SSE streaming and map headers. Suggest compatibility shim: translate POST /v1/complete -> POST /redwood/generate and copy `X-Client-Attrs` into `metadata`.
Liam Chen: Example quick shim (node):
```js
app.post('/v1/complete', async (req, res) => {
  const body = req.body;
  const meta = req.headers['x-client-attrs'];
  const resp = await redwood.generate({input: body.prompt, metadata: meta});
  streamSSE(resp, res);
});
```
Ava Gomez: Nice. We should test tokenization deltas — same prompt may tokenize differently and affect billing and output. Samir, can you run a small prompt-parity eval?
Samir Kapoor: On it. Running 100 prompts from their corpus now. Will share diffs in a doc.
Jordan Lee: Pricing: they asked if we can match per-token pricing for first 6 months + a migration credit. Sales suggested 25% discount for first quarter if they commit to Dedicated in 6 months. Thoughts?
Maya Patel: That sounds reasonable as a bridge. Also offer a fixed ingress egress cap for the POC to avoid bill surprises.
Liam Chen: From infra side — latency target: their SLAs need p95 < 220ms for 512 tokens. On our Hosted plan we hit ~180ms on avg but p95 spikes with bursts. Dedicated will stabilize that. For the POC we can spin a small dedicated pool for 48h smoke.
Ava Gomez: Add a canary fallback plan: if latency > 500ms, route to lower-capacity model with same surface. Document it in the rollout plan.
Maya Patel: Security questionnaire: Saltbox's vendor assessment requires HSM for key import, SOC2 mention, and e2e encryption at rest for cached prefixes.
sec-bot: Automated scan finished: "KMS integration: supported via GovKMS connector (docs: https://internal.redwood/kms). HSM: requires Dedicated or Private deployment. Cache encryption: available via customer key wrap."
Samir Kapoor: Results from prompt-parity eval (quick summary): 100 prompts -> 82 exact semantic parity, 12 minor formatting diffs (punctuation/whitespace), 6 substantive differences on instruction-following. I'll attach full diffs to the shared doc. Link: https://docs.redwood/saltbox-parity-report
Jordan Lee: The 6 substantive differences — can we narrow to config changes (temperature, stop tokens, tokenization)?
Liam Chen: Likely: different tokenizers + truncation behavior. We can offer a compatibility config set: `tokenizer=byte-pair-v2`, `truncate=right`, `stop-seq` replicate their agent.
Maya Patel: Action items:
- Samir: upload full diff + representative failing prompts by EOD (1718618000).
- Liam: prepare 48h Dedicated pool schedule and canary routing plan.
- Ava: draft a one-page security checklist answers for their vendor questionnaire.
- Jordan: confirm commercial offer (6mo bridge discount + migration credit) and draft SOW template.
Samir Kapoor: Uploaded diffs to doc and added examples. Also included a small normalization shim suggestion to fix punctuation drift: `normalizeWhitespace` + deterministic `stop-token` handling.
Ava Gomez: Drafted the security checklist — will include KMS/HSM notes and a sample audit log snippet.
Ava Gomez: Sample audit log format (redacted):
```text
2026-04-01T10:12:23Z user=saltbox-app action=generate model=gpt-redwood-v1 latency_ms=174 tokens_in=45 tokens_out=132 request_id=abc123
```
Jordan Lee: Sales note — Saltbox procurement asked about EULA assignment and DPAs. Legal will need to sign off on data residency addendum. @legal FYI (cc Maya).
Maya Patel: Legal already flagged two items earlier: liability cap and subprocessor list. I'll loop them in.
Liam Chen: For the POC ops: recommend smoke tests:
1) 200 concurrent short requests (<=32 tokens) measure p99.
2) 50 streaming sessions for 10s.
3) prompt-parity run with their corpus.
Samir Kapoor: I can provision the parity harness in our CI and run it during the Dedicated window.
sec-bot: Note: For Private deployment, network egress IPs will be customer-controlled. For now, POC with Dedicated is fastest.
Jordan Lee: Timeline? Saltbox wants results by next Friday. That's 6 business days. Can we meet that?
Liam Chen: Tight but doable if we get approvals tomorrow. Need SRE ops window + billing sign-off.
Maya Patel: I'm scheduling a short kickoff with Saltbox for tomorrow 10am PT. I'll attach the checklist and the initial SOW draft in the meeting invite.
Ava Gomez: I'll prepare the security checklist and vendor questionnaire answers before the kickoff.
Jordan Lee: I'll draft the commercial terms and include a POC cap line item so finance can approve quickly.
Maya Patel: Great. If anyone hits a blocker call out here and I'll escalate to Eng Leadership. :thumbsup:
Samir Kapoor: One nuance — some prompts with HTML input rendered differently. I'll mark those as high priority in the doc.
Liam Chen: Noted. We have a normalization middleware we can apply in the shim to canonicalize HTML input.
Maya Patel: Thanks team. I'll post the meeting invite and link to the parity doc in 15m.
Solutions-bot: Meeting created: Saltbox POC kickoff — Tomorrow 2026-04-02 10:00 PT — calendar link: https://cal.redwood/saltbox-poc
Maya Patel: Closing loop — final ask: any objections to offering the 25% first-quarter discount + $10k migration credit if they sign Dedicated within 6 months?
Jordan Lee: No objections from my side. Finance check pending.
Ava Gomez: Fine from security side if we restrict HSM to Dedicated/Private and document key residency.
Liam Chen: No infra objections.
Samir Kapoor: Fine. I'll prioritize parity fixes.
Maya Patel: Perfect. I'll update the invite with action items.
